Host wrapper allocation covariate: native adapter Buf<int>::get allocates a one-element std::vector on each adaptive-bounds readback; original native CLI copies directly into stack integers. Julia uses preallocated hB copy buffers, but its pipeline(false) constructs two empty trace vectors. These named instrumented-host-pipeline timings include wrapper differences; no causal pure-frontend or kernel-only performance claim.

Native and all Julia paths preserve serial boundary update order, including overlapping corner momentum updates and original Jmin>=NLat-1 bottom-corner condition. Coverage does not establish physical completeness of those boundary rules.

Independent oracle uses Float64 vectorized mass/momentum and hypot boundary magnitudes, but explicitly adopts source boundary/area policy; complementary equilibrium/discrete-balance invariants are not validated tsunami forecasts.

Source host preparation has an R2 assignment in the final-latitude coefficient branch; that geographic initializer is excluded and no unchanged-original fullCLI certification is implied. No observed failure of that excluded scope claimed.
Wave case dry island, arrival times, positive height maxima and adaptive growth covered; negative height maximum magnitude is not the source Hmax observable.

One authored program/four kernel definitions per model; first actual JIT/check passes. KA had one configuration reuse rejection before GPU/JIT due copied command-list mutation, then same body passed; not a compiler or numerical failure.

Historical surrogate restoration separately costed, old attempts/tokens unknown. Prospective usage windows include context/cache/coordination and shared workflow overlaps; JACC also includes queue/deadlock coordination, not exclusive billed cost.

scientific_intent.scientific_task: Advance water-surface elevation and staggered depth-integrated fluxes, positive elevation maxima and first threshold-arrival times, radiation-boundary updates and threshold-grown active rectangle.
scientific_intent.mathematical_operation: eta_next=eta-R1*(Mx-Mx_left+Ny*R6-Ny_down*R6_down); Mx_next=Mx-R2*Delta_x eta; Ny_next=Ny-R4*Delta_y eta; source radiation norms, threshold clipping/arrival/maxima and adaptive bounds follow in original order.
accuracy_requirements: Complete timed final node fields and full four-stage/eight-step diagnostic trajectories within1e-7+1e-5*|oracle| against independent Float64 evaluator
All32bounds/caseandarrival-timefields exact; drycoefficientsreadonly; resting-equilibriumexact; discrete interior mass/momentum residuals andmaxima/bounds monotonicity audited
scientific_intent.community_use_case: Source-backed shallow-water stencil, boundary and data-dependent host-control translation study; no seismic-source/geographic/tsunami-risk prediction validation.
